transcript: My name is Chessura Bandara, and I am a final year IT undergraduate interested in a front-end developer role. I practiced React, JavaScript, and Bootstrap through projects. One project was a bus tracking mobile app for transport. My work was outtracking. We faced GPS delay, so I helped test a solution. The final system improved tracking accuracy.
feedback: You clearly explained your project experience and how it relates to the front-end developer role. However, your answer could be more structured and detailed.
strengths: Practical experience with React, JavaScript, and Bootstrap
weaknesses: Lack of clear structure in the answer
suggestions: Provide a clear introduction to the project and your role in it
Elaborate on the technical skills used and their applications
better_answer_example: For example, you could say: 'In my final year project, I worked on a bus tracking mobile app using React, JavaScript, and Bootstrap. As the front-end developer, my main responsibility was to design and implement the user interface. I successfully implemented a real-time tracking feature using GPS data, which improved the accuracy of the system. Through this project, I gained hands-on experience with front-end development and am confident in my ability to apply these skills in a real-world setting.'
